rationale: The three private reference frames were viewed again. Thin warm-white or pale-pink edges remain distinct beside dark hair and garment lines, on both lit sides, without replacing the characters' painted colors.

The v1 preview has weak secondary-side coverage and early suppression of bright hair/cloth rims. This patch raises secondary-side radiance and retains more existing highlight headroom, while a separate abs(N dot View) permission limits the contour source.
Colors are low-chroma linear RGB tints, closer to warm white and pale rose than yellow. HDR gain is independent of width power, direction permission and the optional view-edge interval.

The view-edge interval is a geometric angular permission, not a fixed pixel-width outline. It is zero beyond abs(N dot View)=0.34 and retains the separate rear-side direction gate; the two lights do not create a uniform entire-silhouette fill.
No new face, neck or hand rim is introduced in this patch. Facial features and the independent face-shadow work retain their original boundaries. Existing skin rims remain as in v1.

Gold/cyan protection, short contact AO, original PMX edge widths/weights, hidden blue/gold arcs, Alpha, physical-metal controls and source textures are preserved. Existing gold/cyan pixels outside Ikhor white permission keep their original rim branch.
validation_scope: JSON/parameter validation and Blender 5.2.2 factory CPU node-construction smoke passed: v1-default creates no view-edge nodes; v2 creates its three optional gate nodes. The production source was not reopened for this smoke. No GPU render, image-quality certification or motion validation. The caller must review glare-on/off, both actors' silhouettes, dark internal lines, white-cloth detail and hand/body overlap at the final framing.
